changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT u.id, 'ROLE_ADMIN' FROM jhi_user u WHERE u.login = 'fsclient' AND fs_manager = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user_authority ua WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND ua.authority_name = 'ROLE_ADMIN')
